sections.changelog:
0.16.11

  • Use Rent Manager Unit Availability profiles to respect prospect reservations, future leases, unit-status exclusions, and configured availability windows.
  • Retain lease-based calculation when the API explicitly lacks profile support or reports a missing profile; preserve inventory on ordinary request failures.
  • Add profile and fallback diagnostics, protect floorplan availability during outages, and reduce memory use for large unit responses.
  • Compatible with rolling API updates. Rent Fetch API 0.4.9 enables profile availability; older APIs retain calculation behavior.
